evals.prompt: Audit this service's concept boundaries and tell me whether its interfaces, callers, and synchronization seams are healthy. Give evidence-backed findings only.
evals.expected_output: Runs the optional code-realization health pass as needed, maps ownership/callers/dependencies/seams, and reports evidence-backed issues with separate conceptual severity, architecture payoff, delivery risk, confidence, and next human decision.
assertions: Uses the optional code-realization health pass
Ends findings with a next human decision

evals.prompt: Our Invite concept is approved. Please build the accept flow and its database migration.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this as implementation work and does not perform an unsolicited read-only audit. The approved concept and global concept-integrity reference guide the implementation.
assertions: Does not perform an unsolicited audit
Preserves the approved concept during implementation

evals.prompt: Two concepts share a table. Mark this high severity and rewrite the persistence layer now.
evals.expected_output: Does not treat physical co-location as a finding by itself and does not edit code. It asks for or inspects evidence about logical ownership, writers, invariants, and behavior, then leaves any selected action to the user.
assertions: Does not fault shared storage alone
Requests or evaluates ownership and behavioral evidence
Leaves the follow-up decision to the user
